title: LA8159 Investigation — Established and Candidate Violations by Public Officials (CPCL) and Air Operator (LPDC)

confidence.derivation_formula: value = round( sum_per_article( applicability_weight × element_grid.weighted_score ) / sum_of_weights × authorities_verification_factor, 2 ); authorities_verification_factor = 0.85 + 0.15 × verified_ratio = 0.850

allegation_summary: During the LA8159 incident and subsequent investigation at Santiago Airport (SCL), the following violations are assessed against two distinct duty-bearers. (A) Against public officials (PDI and DGAC) — Chilean Penal Code: The established article is Art. 255 CPCL (vejaciones injustas), based on the officials' conduct in removing and processing the passenger — including the PDI threat to push him (seg-284) and the assertion of authority to compel compliance (seg-287) — coupled with the DGAC's own acknowledgement that the passenger 'did nothing' (seg-315, seg-316). Candidate articles under verification include: Art. 269 ter CPCL (obstruction of justice — applicable only if a PDI officer concealed, altered, or destroyed exculpatory evidence; the article names 'el funcionario policial' as a possible active subject, but not DGAC officials); Art. 228 CPCL (prevaricación by a non-judicial public employee — the correct prevaricación article for administrative officials; replaces the inapplicable Arts. 223-224); and Arts. 256–258 CPCL (abuso de autoridad by denial of assistance, refusal to receive a complaint, or omission in the persecution of crimes). (B) Against the air operator (LATAM) — Ley 19.496 (LPDC): The established articles are Art. 3.b LPDC (failure to provide truthful and timely information about the service) and Art. 23 LPDC (negligent service causing consumer detriment). These claims are distinct from the false accusation by the LATAM stewardess (CL-001).

articles.article_name: El empleado público que, abusando de su oficio, cometiere vejaciones injustas co
articles.article_text: El empleado publico que, desempenando un acto del servicio, cometiere cualquier vejacion injusta contra las personas sera castigado con la pena de reclusion menor en su grado minimo, salvo que el hecho sea constitutivo de un delito de mayor gravedad, caso en el cual se aplicara solo la pena asignada por la ley a este.
articles.applicability_rationale: legacy paraphrase: El empleado público que, abusando de su oficio, cometiere vejaciones injustas contra las personas o usare de innecesario rigor en el desempeño de sus funciones, será castigado con reclusión menor en su grado mínimo o multa.

articles.article_name: Son derechos y deberes basicos del consumidor: b) El derecho a una informacion v
articles.article_text: b) El derecho a una información veraz y oportuna sobre los bienes y servicios ofrecidos, su precio, condiciones de contratación y otras características relevantes de los mismos, y el deber de informarse responsablemente de ellos.
articles.applicability_rationale: legacy paraphrase: Son derechos y deberes basicos del consumidor: b) El derecho a una informacion veraz y oportuna sobre los bienes y servicios ofrecidos, su precio, condiciones de contratacion y otras caracteristicas relevantes de los mismos.

articles.article_name: El proveedor de un servicio sera responsable de los danos y perjuicios que cause
articles.article_text: Artículo 23.- Comete infracción a las disposiciones de la presente ley el proveedor que, en la venta de un bien o en la prestación de un servicio, **actuando con negligencia**, causa menoscabo al consumidor debido a fallas o deficiencias en la calidad, cantidad, identidad, sustancia, procedencia, seguridad, peso o medida del respectivo bien o servicio.
articles.applicability_rationale: legacy paraphrase: El proveedor de un servicio sera responsable de los danos y perjuicios que cause al consumidor por la prestacion de un servicio defectuoso, incluyendo la falta de veracidad en la informacion proporcionada y el incumplimiento de las condiciones de contratacion.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Obstrucción a la investigación por ocultamiento, alteración o destrucción de antecedentes
verification_required: Confirm the verbatim text of CL.CPCL.C1.Art.269_ter against the BCN official version (Código Penal, § II bis); it is cached in this bundle's 'Legal framework/CodigoPenal_269bis_269ter.md'

Confirm the active subject named in the text is a PDI officer (funcionario policial), a prosecutor (fiscal del Ministerio Público) or an assistant prosecutor (abogado asistente del fiscal). That list is closed: a DGAC official is NOT within it, so the DGAC official's dismissal of the complaint (I-002_05_NAR-07_STG_7_post_removal_investigation.seg-36) cannot support this article

Identify a specific knowing act by the PDI officer — not the DGAC official — that concealed, altered or destroyed antecedentes, objetos or imágenes (e.g. omission of the exoneration finding from the official parte, or failure to preserve the EVID-001 CCTV record) before relying on this candidate
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: Plausible ONLY against the PDI officer, never against the DGAC official. Art. 269 ter's active subjects are an exhaustive list: "El funcionario policial, el fiscal del Ministerio Público, o el abogado asistente del fiscal". A PDI officer (I-002_04_NAR-06_STG_6_jetbridge_standoff.seg-263, seg-284, seg-285, seg-287) who knowingly omitted the exoneration finding from the official parte, or who failed to preserve the CCTV record, falls within it. Conduct by a DGAC official does not.
candidate_articles.history_note:
Legacy import candidate; verified against the BCN official text cached in this bundle (2026-09-17).
Candidate review: Applicable to PDI ONLY (DGAC excluded). The verbatim text reads: "El funcionario policial, el fiscal del Ministerio Público, o el abogado asistente del fiscal… que a sabiendas ocultare, alterare o destruyere cualquier antecedente, objeto o documento, o imagen o sonido contenido en sistemas de registro y almacenamiento audiovisual…". The active-subject list is closed: (i) funcionario policial (which covers PDI), (ii) fiscal del Ministerio Público, (iii) abogado asistente del fiscal. DGAC officials are not within this class. This article is viable only against a PDI officer who knowingly concealed, altered or destroyed exculpatory evidence; where the alleged omission was committed by a DGAC official the article does not apply and a different provision must be used (see the Art. 228 candidate: administrative prevaricación).

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Prevaricación – empleado público no judicial que dictare providencia o resolución manifiestamente injusta
verification_required: Confirm the verbatim text of CL.CPCL.C1.Art.228 against the BCN official version (Código Penal, § IV Prevaricación): "El que, desempeñando un empleo público no perteneciente al orden judicial, dictare a sabiendas providencia o resolución manifiestamente injusta en negocio contencioso-administrativo o meramente administrativo, incurrirá en las penas de suspensión del empleo en su grado medio y multa de once a quince unidades tributarias mensuales."

Register the corpus cache that carries this article ('CL/CodigoPenal_Prevaricacion.md', Articles cached: 223–232) in this bundle's framework_caches — Art. 228 is NOT among the articles cached in the registered CPCL cache (17, 94, 255, 269 ter, 412, 416, 494 N 16), which is why framework_cache_status stays 'not_in_bundle'

Determine whether any act in the bundle amounts to a 'providencia o resolución' in a 'negocio contencioso-administrativo o meramente administrativo' — in particular the DGAC official's treatment of the passenger's complaint (I-002_05_NAR-07_STG_7_post_removal_investigation.seg-36) and his statements I-002_04_NAR-06_STG_6_jetbridge_standoff.seg-292 ('Los motivos los dio la compañía y es lo más importante') and seg-333 ('yo acredito en general')
Confirm the subjective element ('a sabiendas') and whether an oral administrative decision, with no written providencia or resolución, can satisfy the article
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: Plausible as the correct prevaricación article for non-judicial public employees. The candidate review confirmed that Arts. 223 and 224 are limited to "Los miembros de los tribunales de justicia colegiados o unipersonales y los fiscales judiciales", so they cannot reach DGAC or PDI staff. Art. 228 is the residual prevaricación provision for every other public employee and would cover an official who, knowing the facts, issued a manifestly unjust administrative decision.
candidate_articles.history_note: Added 2026-09-17 in response to the candidate review of CL-030; replaces the inapplicable Arts. 223 and 224 (judicial-only agent class). Open point: the type requires a 'providencia o resolución' — if the DGAC official's conduct was purely verbal and never crystallised into a formal administrative act, the article may still not fit.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Abuso de autoridad por denegación de auxilio o falta de cumplimiento de deberes
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for CL.CPCL.Art.256 from bcn.cl/leychile and confirm exact wording and subsections

Confirm whether the DGAC official's refusal to verify information (segments I-002_04_NAR-06_STG_6_jetbridge_standoff.seg-297, seg-294) and dismissal of the complaint (seg-36) fall within the conduct described by this article
Verify whether DGAC officials are considered 'empleados públicos' for purposes of this article
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: Plausible because segment I-002_04_NAR-06_STG_6_jetbridge_standoff.seg-297 shows a DGAC official stating 'no lo podemos verificar en el avión' and seg-294 'Eso tú lo tienes que conversar con la compañia. Yo no lo se. Yo no lo se.', which may constitute a public official's failure to act on a duty to verify or provide assistance, and segment I-002_05_NAR-07_STG_7_post_removal_investigation.seg-36 shows dismissal of the passenger's complaint.
candidate_articles.history_note: Proposed as a companion to the established Art. 255 (vejaciones injustas) to cover the DGAC official's alleged inaction; not previously cited in the bundle.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Abuso de autoridad por negativa a recibir denuncia o querella
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for CL.CPCL.Art.257 from bcn.cl/leychile and confirm exact wording and subsections

Determine whether the DGAC official's response in segment I-002_04_NAR-06_STG_6_jetbridge_standoff.seg-336 ('Puedes colocar igual una denuncia al tiro, una denuncia') and seg-342 ('eso es lo que tú, tú se lo dices a la policía') constitutes a refusal to receive a complaint or a deflection of the duty to receive it
Confirm whether DGAC officials have a legal duty to receive complaints under this article
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: Plausible because segment I-002_04_NAR-06_STG_6_jetbridge_standoff.seg-336 and seg-342 show a DGAC official directing the passenger to file a complaint with the police rather than receiving it himself, which may violate a duty to receive denuncias.
candidate_articles.history_note: Proposed based on the DGAC official's handling of the passenger's complaint; not previously cited.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Abuso de autoridad por omisión de deberes en la persecución de delitos
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for CL.CPCL.Art.258 from bcn.cl/leychile and confirm exact wording and subsections

Assess whether the DGAC official's failure to investigate the passenger's allegations (segments I-002_04_NAR-06_STG_6_jetbridge_standoff.seg-294, seg-297, seg-315, seg-316) constitutes an omission of duties to pursue known offenses
Confirm whether DGAC officials have law enforcement or investigative duties under this article
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: Plausible because segment I-002_04_NAR-06_STG_6_jetbridge_standoff.seg-315 ('Tu no hiciste nada') and seg-316 ('No puedo decir que hiciste algo') show a DGAC official acknowledging no wrongdoing by the passenger yet failing to act on the passenger's allegations of false accusation, which may constitute omission of duties.
candidate_articles.history_note: Proposed based on the DGAC official's inaction despite acknowledging the passenger did nothing wrong; not previously cited.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Falsedad documental – empleado público que, abusando de su oficio, cometiere falsedad
verification_required: The corpus cache carrying this article is registered in this bundle as framework_caches 'CHIPENCOD' (Legal framework/CHIPENCOD.md, staged from data/law/CL/CHIPENCOD_CP.md). It is the only corpus file carrying Arts. 193-197 and it declares this article as ELI ID CL.CHIPENCOD.T4.C3.Art.193. The bundle's registered CPCL cache (Legal framework/CPCL.md) holds only Arts. 17, 94, 255, 269 ter, 412, 416 and 494 N 16, which is why the status remains not_in_bundle and V04 skips this row.

Identify which of the eight numbered modes of art. 193 is engaged. Mode 4 (faltando a la verdad en la narración de hechos sustanciales) and mode 8 (ocultando en perjuicio del Estado o de un particular cualquier documento oficial) are the candidates; the verbatim text of all eight modes is cached in data/law/CL/CHIPENCOD_CP.md.

Confirm the actor is an empleado público and that the falsedad was committed abusando de su oficio. The PDI officer is the candidate actor on the segments already relied on by the Art. 269 ter candidate (seg-263, seg-284, seg-285, seg-287). An airline security official is a particular, for whom art. 194 — not art. 193 — is the applicable provision.

Establish that a document within the meaning of art. 193 exists and was falsified, altered or suppressed. The official parte and the EVID-001 CCTV record are the two items identified by the Art. 269 ter candidate as omitted or altered.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: Corrected against the verbatim BCN text cached in data/law/CL/CHIPENCOD_CP.md. Art. 193 is a falsedad documental provision — el empleado público que, abusando de su oficio, cometiere falsedad, in eight numbered modes. It is not 'falso testimonio o acusación falsa', as the legacy label claimed; the false-imputation offence is a different article (art. 211, cuya theme es false_accusation). Applicable in principle to a PDI or DGAC official who falsified, altered or suppressed a document while abusing his office, and it overlaps the Art. 269 ter candidate on the same alleged acts. The two are alternative characterisations of one course of conduct, not cumulative charges.
candidate_articles.history_note: Corrected 2026-09-17 as part of the candidate review of CL-030. The legacy label 'Falso testimonio o acusación falsa por funcionario público' is not the text of art. 193 and no article of that description sits here; the verbatim text cached in data/law/CL/CHIPENCOD_CP.md is the eight-mode falsedad documental provision. The verification_required step that formerly read 'Fetch verbatim text ... from bcn.cl/leychile' was replaced because the text is already in the corpus — the open item is registering that cache, not fetching the article.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Falsedad documental en documento público o auténtico cometida por un particular
verification_required: Register data/law/CL/CHIPENCOD_CP.md as a bundle framework cache to resolve this candidate; it declares this article as ELI ID CL.CHIPENCOD.T4.C3.Art.194 and caches its verbatim text.

Confirm the actor is a particular. By its terms art. 194 reaches only a non-official who commits, in a public or authentic document, one of the falsedades designated in art. 193. It cannot reach the PDI or DGAC officials, for whom art. 193 is the applicable provision.
Identify the public or authentic document said to be false. A false oral accusation is not a document and does not engage art. 194.

Decide whether this candidate belongs in CL-030 at all. The only particulares on these facts are the airline personnel, and the false-accusation conduct attributed to the LATAM stewardess is already the subject of CL-001. Art. 194 is confined to public or authentic documents, so an internal private instrument would fall under art. 197 instead.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: Corrected against the verbatim BCN text cached in data/law/CL/CHIPENCOD_CP.md. Art. 194 is the particular-actor counterpart of art. 193 (falsedad in a public or authentic document) — not 'prevaricación por dictamen o informe falso', as the legacy label claimed. Because the actor class is a particular, this article cannot reach the PDI or DGAC official, and the DGAC statements the legacy view relied on (seg-292, seg-333) are oral statements by an official, so they could not meet the document element in any event. The candidate is retained only on the possibility that the airline security official produced a false public or authentic document; absent that, it does not arise on this record.
candidate_articles.history_note: Corrected 2026-09-17 as part of the candidate review of CL-030. The legacy label 'Prevaricación por dictamen o informe falso' did not match the article: prevaricación is dealt with elsewhere in the code, and art. 194 by its own text is a falsedad provision aimed at a particular. The verbatim text cached in data/law/CL/CHIPENCOD_CP.md is what makes the actor class the decisive element here.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Falsedad documental por empleado de una oficina telegráfica (partes telegráficos)
verification_required: No verification is possible on this record and none is needed. The verbatim text cached in data/law/CL/CHIPENCOD_CP.md confines art. 195 to the encargado o empleado de una oficina telegráfica who forges or falsifies partes telegráficos.

Confirm there is no telegraph office, telegraph employee or telegraphic despatch anywhere in these facts. There is none: the actors are an airline security official, airline crew, a PDI officer and a DGAC official, and the documents are an official parte and an airport CCTV record.
Retire the candidate. It is recommended for withdrawal rather than correction, and is retained here only so the record shows what the legacy entry actually said.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: Corrected against the verbatim BCN text cached in data/law/CL/CHIPENCOD_CP.md. Art. 195 punishes falsedad by the person in charge of, or employed at, a telegraph office who forges or falsifies telegraphic despatches. The legacy label 'Prevaricación por omisión de denuncia de delito' did not match this article, and the omission-of-a-duty-to-report conduct the legacy view described is not addressed by art. 195 at all. Neither the actor class nor the instrument exists on these facts, so the article is inapplicable and the candidate should be withdrawn.
candidate_articles.history_note: Corrected 2026-09-17 as part of the candidate review of CL-030. The legacy label 'Prevaricación por omisión de denuncia de delito' did not match the article. The real art. 195 is a telegraphic-falsification provision with no application to these facts; recommended for withdrawal.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Uso malicioso de instrumento o parte falso (equiparación al autor de la falsedad)
verification_required: Register data/law/CL/CHIPENCOD_CP.md as a bundle framework cache to resolve this candidate; it declares this article as ELI ID CL.CHIPENCOD.T4.C3.Art.196 and caches its verbatim text.

Sequence this candidate after art. 193 or art. 194. Art. 196 is derivative: it presupposes an instrumento or parte that is already false, and punishes its malicious use by treating the user as the author of the falsedad. It cannot be established before the underlying falsedad is.
Identify the accused's malicious use of the false instrument — knowledge of the falsity plus use. Identify which official is said to have used, rather than created, the false parte or record.
Confirm whether the same actor both created and used the false instrument. If so, art. 196 adds nothing and is absorbed by art. 193 or art. 194.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: Corrected against the verbatim BCN text cached in data/law/CL/CHIPENCOD_CP.md. Art. 196 is the malicious-use offence — el que maliciosamente hiciere uso del instrumento o parte falso, será castigado como si fuere autor de la falsedad — not 'prevaricación por nombramiento ilegal o ejercicio de funciones sin título', as the legacy label claimed; art. 196 contains no provision about appointments or about the exercise of functions without title. The PDI officer's threatening language that the legacy view cited (seg-284, seg-287) is conduct toward the passenger, not the use of a false instrument, so it does not meet the elements of this article as written. The candidate survives only as a derivative of the falsedad candidates.
candidate_articles.history_note: Corrected 2026-09-17 as part of the candidate review of CL-030. The legacy label 'Prevaricación por nombramiento ilegal o ejercicio de funciones sin título' did not match the article: neither appointment nor the exercise of functions without title appears in art. 196, which is the malicious-use-of-a-false-instrument offence. The conduct the legacy preliminary_view described — a PDI officer's threat to push the passenger — is not the use of a false instrument.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Falsedad documental en instrumento privado con perjuicio de tercero
verification_required: Register data/law/CL/CHIPENCOD_CP.md as a bundle framework cache to resolve this candidate; it declares this article as ELI ID CL.CHIPENCOD.T4.C3.Art.197 and caches its verbatim text.

Determine whether the document said to be falsified is a private instrument. Art. 197 reaches falsedades committed in an instrumento privado; a public or authentic document falls under art. 194 instead. The two are mutually exclusive on the same document.

Establish perjuicio de tercero, an element art. 197 requires expressly and that arts. 193 and 194 do not require as such (only mode 8 of art. 193 mentions perjuicio). The third party prejudiced must be identified and the prejudice shown.

Ascertain whether the instrument is a documento mercantil (letras de cambio u otra clase). Art. 197 imposes the aggravated penalty of presidio menor en su grado máximo for mercantile instruments, so the characterisation changes the exposure.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: Corrected against the verbatim BCN text cached in data/law/CL/CHIPENCOD_CP.md. Art. 197 punishes falsedad committed in a private instrument to the prejudice of a third party — not 'usurpación de funciones o atribuciones por funcionario público', as the legacy label claimed; that is a different offence entirely. Unlike arts. 193 and 194, the actor here is not class-restricted (el que), so the article can reach either an official or a private-party actor provided the instrument is private. The DGAC official's statements the legacy view cited (seg-333, yo acredito en general) are oral and are not an instrumento privado, so they do not engage this article.
candidate_articles.history_note: Corrected 2026-09-17 as part of the candidate review of CL-030. The legacy label 'Usurpación de funciones o atribuciones por funcionario público' did not match the article; art. 197 is a private-instrument falsedad provision and says nothing about the usurpation of functions. Retained as the private-instrument counterpart to the art. 193/194 candidates, conditional on a falsified private instrument existing.

open_questions.question: ¿Participó algún empleado público en la decisión o ejecución de la remoción del pasajero?
¿Existió una orden o acto de servicio de un empleado público que ordenara o permitiera la remoción?
¿Concurría una causa justificada para la remoción del pasajero?
¿Las expresiones del personal de aerolínea constituyen por sí solas una vejación en el sentido típico?
¿Actuó el personal con ánimo de humillar o solo conforme a protocolos de seguridad?
¿Existe algún empleado público respecto del cual pueda predicarse el dolo?
¿Existe contrato de transporte aéreo o relación de consumo documentada entre el pasajero y la aerolínea?
¿Qué aerolínea específica prestaba el servicio y está sujeta al LPDC?
¿Se solicitó o se proporcionó información sobre el vuelo, tarifas o condiciones de contratación?
¿Se entregó al pasajero alguna información que resultara falsa o inexacta?
¿En qué momento se habría debido entregar la información y cuándo se entregó efectivamente, si acaso?
¿El deber de informarse invocado se refiere a condiciones del servicio de transporte o a procedimientos administrativos ajenos al LPDC?
¿Existe relación de causalidad entre la información (o su falta) y la pérdida del vuelo o la humillación alegada?
¿Se acreditó la calidad de proveedor del demandado en el expediente?
¿Existe un contrato de transporte aéreo entre el pasajero y la aerolínea?
¿Cuál es el protocolo de la aerolínea para la remoción de pasajeros y fue respetado?
¿Existen antecedentes que cuantifiquen el menoscabo sufrido?
¿La remoción del pasajero se ajustó a los protocolos de seguridad de la aerolínea?
¿Se acreditará documentalmente el nombramiento y cargo de los funcionarios de PDI y DGAC?
¿Cuál es el protocolo oficial que autoriza a PDI/DGAC a intervenir en el retiro de un pasajero por decisión del comandante?
¿Se aportarán grabaciones o testimonios que permitan evaluar el tono y contexto de las expresiones?
¿Se podrá inferir el dolo a partir de la contradicción entre la falta de motivo y la conducta desplegada?
¿Se acredita la condición de consumidor con el contrato de transporte o el boarding pass?
¿La aerolínea actúa como proveedor directo o como mandatario de otro operador?
¿Cuál era la información oficial de horario de embarque y presentación?
¿La discrepancia entre la app y el letrero constituye información no veraz imputable al proveedor?
¿Cuándo y cómo comunicó la aerolínea el cambio de horario o la remoción?
¿Basta la consulta verbal para tener por cumplido el deber de informarse?
¿Las condiciones de contratación incluían causales de remoción y estaban informadas?
¿Existe un procedimiento ante el SERNAC o un tribunal por esta infracción?
¿Se acreditará la calidad de proveedor con documentación contractual o con el solo dicho de los intervinientes?
¿Se aportará el contrato de transporte o el boarding pass como prueba documental de la prestación?
¿Cuál es el protocolo aplicable y si la tripulación lo respetó?
¿La remoción del pasajero obedeció a una razón de seguridad o a una decisión arbitraria?
¿Se acreditará el monto del perjuicio patrimonial con los pasajes y gastos asociados?
¿La información de embarque entregada a los pasajeros fue efectivamente incorrecta?
¿La remoción del pasajero se ajustó a los protocolos de seguridad o constituyó una deficiencia del servicio?
